source.notes: 1,000,000 synthetic SimpleFeatures (2 bp each, an integer score, a strand) through encodeFeatures, nine arms interleaved round-robin in one node 24 process on AC power, min of 9 rounds. Every arm packs x/x2/y, builds the Flatbush and skips the same features; the identity check compares count, x and y across arms first. 'native' reads score with feature.get and packs a constant colour; 'control' is the same encoding declared a second time, so its ratio is the harness's own resolution; 'jexl-y' reads score through a jexl: expression, one evaluation per feature; 'jexl-color' reads score natively and colours through a jexl ternary, one evaluation per feature with its CSS answer parsed once per distinct string; 'scale-color' colours through a categorical scale over strand, a field read and a table lookup per feature plus one pass after the walk; 'jexl-glyph' and 'scale-glyph' are the same pair for the glyph channel. The first seven ask for the point shape's lanes and the hit index; 'no-index' is the native encoding without the Flatbush, and 'wiggle' is the array-less wiggle fallback's call — y as a reader, the y lane alone, no jexl instance. Re-measured with the lane arms on 2026-09-09, load average under 2. Absolute times drift about 2x between runs on this shared box; the within-run ratios held across three runs. 'vs native' is typed rather than derived because it divides by another row.
